reference_sql:
WITH store_lines AS (
  -- one row per order line of 2025, with its store and its UTC quarter
  SELECT o.store_id, quarter(o.order_ts) AS quarter_no,
         ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT s.store_code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sl.quarter_no = 1 THEN sl.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS q1_revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sl.quarter_no = 2 THEN sl.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS q2_revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sl.quarter_no = 3 THEN sl.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS q3_revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sl.quarter_no = 4 THEN sl.net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS q4_revenue_eur
FROM store_lines AS sl
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = sl.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
ORDER BY s.store_code
alternatives:
WITH store_lines AS (
  -- one row per order line of 2025, with its store and its UTC quarter
  SELECT s.store_code, 'q' || quarter(o.order_ts) AS quarter_name,
         ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
wide AS (
  -- one row per store, one column per quarter, missing where the store sold nothing
  PIVOT store_lines ON quarter_name IN ('q1', 'q2', 'q3', 'q4') USING SUM(net_revenue_eur) GROUP BY store_code
)
SELECT store_code,
       COALESCE(q1, 0) AS q1_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(q2, 0) AS q2_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(q3, 0) AS q3_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(q4, 0) AS q4_revenue_eur
FROM wide
ORDER BY store_code

SELECT store_code,
       COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE order_date < DATE '2025-04-01'), 0) AS q1_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-07-01'), 0) AS q2_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-10-01'), 0) AS q3_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-10-01'), 0) AS q4_revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY store_code
ORDER BY store_code

WITH store_quarters AS (
  -- one row per store and UTC quarter of 2025 in which it sold
  SELECT s.store_code, quarter(o.order_ts) AS quarter_no,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY s.store_code, quarter(o.order_ts)
)
SELECT store_code,
       COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN quarter_no = 1 THEN net_revenue_eur END), 0) AS q1_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN quarter_no = 2 THEN net_revenue_eur END), 0) AS q2_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN quarter_no = 3 THEN net_revenue_eur END), 0) AS q3_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN quarter_no = 4 THEN net_revenue_eur END), 0) AS q4_revenue_eur
FROM store_quarters
GROUP BY store_code
ORDER BY store_code

solver.query:
SELECT s.store_code,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' THEN l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur END), 0) AS q1_revenue_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01' THEN l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur END), 0) AS q2_revenue_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01' THEN l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur END), 0) AS q3_revenue_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01' THEN l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur END), 0) AS q4_revenue_eur
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY s.store_code
ORDER BY s.store_code
